name: Cardinality
short_description: In Power BI data modeling, cardinality describes how often values can repeat on each side of a relationship: one-to-many, many-to-one, one-to-one or many-to-many.

evidence.quote: Cardinality. The word that decides which table leads cardinality sounds like one of those words
it defaults to a many to many join because both tables include overlapping keys
